parsed.note_claim: All JAL 516 passengers survived; the DHC-8 had five fatalities and one survivor.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Five of the six crew on board the Dash 8 died in the collision, leaving only the captain alive. Everyone on board the A350 survived.
parsed.reason: The page confirms the collision date, location, and explicitly states the survival and fatality counts for both aircraft matching the note.
